T: Thawed out and ready to eat, buddy.
D: Two high school losers dig up a frozen caveman in their backyard and pass him off as an exchange student.
P: Serve the snacks when Link is thawed out in the garage.
S: Link's ice block cheddar cheese ball
the caveman frozen in a block of ice

Sharp cheddar and cream cheese beaten with pickled jalapeño and smoked paprika, rolled in crushed pretzels and bacon, served on ice with crackers. Beat 250g soft cream cheese with 200g grated sharp cheddar, 2 tbsp chopped pickled jalapeño, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tsp Worcestershire. Shape into a ball, wrap and chill 2 hours. Fry 4 rashers bacon until crisp and crumble with 60g crushed pretzels and chopped chives. Roll the ball in the crumb and serve on a plate of crushed ice with crackers.
Chicken drumsticks rubbed with smoked paprika, garlic and brown sugar, roasted at 220C for 40 minutes until sticky, eaten with your hands like a caveman.
the backyard where they dig the pool

Corn chips baked under black beans, chorizo and two cheeses, piled with guacamole, sour cream, pickled jalapeño and a squeeze of lime. Fry 1 diced chorizo until crisp. Layer 300g corn chips on a tray with the chorizo, 1 drained tin black beans, 150g grated cheddar and 100g grated mozzarella, and bake at 200C for 8 minutes. Mash 2 avocados with lime and salt. Top the nachos with guacamole, sour cream, pickled jalapeños, coriander and lime wedges.
M: the backyard pool where they dig him up
Chicken thigh skewers marinated in teriyaki, ginger and garlic, grilled and served with rice and sesame.
a big hunk of meat for a big appetite

Pork ribs rubbed in brown sugar and smoked paprika, baked low until tender, then charred under the grill with sticky barbecue glaze. Eat with your hands. Mix 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp salt and pepper and rub over 2kg pork ribs. Wrap tightly in foil and bake at 150C for 2.5 hours. Mix 200ml barbecue sauce with 2 tbsp honey and 1 tbsp cider vinegar. Unwrap the ribs, brush with the glaze and grill for 5 minutes a side until sticky and charred. Serve with coleslaw.
W: Greek yoghurt mixed with honey and vanilla, spread thin on a tray, scattered with berries and crushed nuts, frozen 4 hours, broken into shards.
K: Stoney and Link wheezin' the juice in 1990s Encino

Mango, banana, pineapple and orange juice blended thick and frosty, with a swirl of strawberry purée up the glass like a California sunset. Blend 200g frozen strawberries with 1 tbsp honey and spoon into the bottom of 4 tall glasses. Blend 2 chopped mangoes, 2 frozen bananas, 200g pineapple, 400ml orange juice and a handful of ice until thick. Pour slowly over the strawberry so it swirls up the sides and serve with a straw.

m.how: Toss 1kg diced chicken thigh in 125ml teriyaki sauce with 1 tbsp grated ginger and 2 crushed garlic cloves and marinate for 30 minutes. Thread onto 12 skewers and grill for 10 to 12 minutes, turning and basting. Serve with steamed rice and sesame seeds.
